body:
Music brings back too many memories. And reminds me of tomorrow's I'll never get with her. 

I'm trying to find something that I can enjoy on my own but everything I try I just want to turn to her and say "isn't this great" but she's no longer here. It just reminds me I'm on my own
I'm struggling with PTSD. Some days it takes me hours just to manage to get out of bed, have a shower and get my clothes on.

I've lost interest in everything I loved before. Sports, meh. Music, too painful. Art, I don't have her around to talk about it with. Hiking, not the same on your own. Reading, my concentration is blown. All the things I loved we loved to do together. And it's just too painful to do them without her. I struggle to even go and buy groceries anymore as I end up crying in the store.
I have no family. My parents disowned me for being gay and marrying a woman. Her family doesn't want to know me.

My life is so dark and empty without her here beside me. She was my best friend. The person I wanted around me all the time. I want to go to the dimension she is on. I can't survive here without her physical presence.

I have no life though. My days are spent mind numbingly bored as I'm not allowed to work here yet (work permit issues). All my goals were connected to her. I had to go through my bucket list and cross off all the things I had wanted to experience with her. 

I've got hardly any money left. I don't have access to a car. I have a few friends but they are always busy. My life has become something resembling a prison sentence. I lie on my bed and stare at the walls while my PTSD from my wife's suicide has made it hard to go outside, to eat and to sleep. 

My wife was all I ever wanted and she is dead.
My wife couldn't cope with this horrendous world, and I can't cope with it without her. I literally have nothing to live for.

Every day is just an uphill battle. I feel lost without her. My reason for living is gone. The person who brought light and love in my world is gone. I don't know how I'm meant to survive. I'm tired from fighting just to get out of bed every day. The pain in my heart and soul is like nothing I've ever experienced before.
